# opnsense_monit_alert (Resource)

Monit alert recipients (**Services ▸ Monit ▸ Settings ▸ Alert Settings**).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_monit_alert" "ops" {
  recipient = "ops@example.com"
  events    = ["nonexist", "pid", "resource"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `recipient` (String) Email address that receives the alerts.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional description here for your reference (not parsed).
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this alert is enabled. Defaults to `true`.
- `events` (Set of String) Events that trigger (or, with `not_on`, do not trigger) an alert. Empty means all events. Defaults to `[]`.
- `format` (String) Custom mail format, see the Monit documentation.
- `not_on` (Boolean) When enabled, `events` lists the events that do **not** trigger an alert. Defaults to `false`.
- `reminder` (Number) Send a reminder every this many cycles while the error persists. Defaults to `-1` (OPNsense default).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the Monit alert.

## Import

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import opnsense_monit_alert using the `id`. For example:

```terraform
import {
  to = opnsense_monit_alert.example
  id = "<opnsense-resource-id>"
}
```

Using `terraform import`, import opnsense_monit_alert using the `id`. For example:

```console
% terraform import opnsense_monit_alert.example <opnsense-resource-id>
```
